title: Submit a Better A2 Route
description: Share a route with the Better A2 community. Attach a route package exported from Better A2 and provide enough detail for the library maintainer to review it.
success_message: Thanks for sharing your route. The library maintainer will review the package before publication.

fields.name: route_name
fields.label: Route name
fields.description: Use a short, recognizable name for the route.

fields.name: resources
fields.label: Resources
fields.description: List the main resources gathered on this route.

fields.name: author_credit
fields.label: Author credit
fields.description: Name or community nickname to display with the route.

fields.name: route_package
fields.label: Better A2 route package (JSON)
fields.description: Upload the JSON package exported from Better A2. JSON only; maximum file size: 10 MB.

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Notes for players
fields.description: Add useful route details such as direction, hazards, or recommended setup.
